name: List All Tenants Notes
description: Returns all tenant notes that meet the filter criteria

queryFilters.name: filters[TenantId]
queryFilters.description: Filter by tenant unique identifier. All GET requests must include a filter for [TenantId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

queryFilters.name: filters[LastUpdatedAtFrom]
queryFilters.description: Filter tenant notes updated at or after this date-time. All GET requests must include a filter for [TenantId] or [LastUpdatedAtFrom].

responseFields.name: data[].Body
responseFields.description: A brief informative message about the tenant note. A tenant note cannot exceed 63,535 characters.

responseFields.name: data[].EntityId
responseFields.description: The tenant to which the note will be attached

responseFields.name: data[].LastUpdatedAt
responseFields.description: The date the tenant note's details were last updated

responseFields.name: data[].Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the tenant

responseFields.name: data[].NoteId
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the note associated with the tenant. Deprecated in favor of Id.

responseFields.name: next_page_path
responseFields.description: The URL path to the next page of responses
